mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_join_requests (group_id, user_id, status, reason, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{reason}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, group_id, user_id, status, reason, created_at, updated_at FROM group_join_requests WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, group_id, user_id, status, reason, created_at, updated_at FROM group_join_requests WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT gjr.id, gjr.group_id, gjr.user_id, u.username, gjr.status, gjr.reason, gjr.created_at FROM group_join_requests gjr JOIN users u ON gjr.user_id = u.user_id WHERE gjr.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY gjr.created_at DESC
